shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g '*config*' -g 'README*' -g '*lock*'"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat src/index.css && cat vite.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/uikit @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -130 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat index.html && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -15 && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(ThemeProvider.d.ts|Checkbox.d.ts|Alert.d.ts|i18n.md|theming.md)"'$'"' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/docs/i18n.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/docs/theming.md | head -95 && cat index.html && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -45 && rg 'ArrowRight|Lock|CircleQuestion|ArrowUpRight|Planet' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/i18n.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/Alert.d.ts && cat index.html && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -12 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -40'

/bin/bash -lc "rg 'Planet|Orbit|ArrowRight|ArrowUpRight|Lock|Envelope|ShieldCheck|CircleQuestion|Sparkles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/types.d.ts | head -110 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.js | head -120 && rg --files node_modules | rg '(playwright|puppeteer)' | head -10"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "ls /tmp && ls /opt && cat .gitignore && git diff --stat && rg 'font-family|src:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css | head -12 && rg 'brand|action' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright --version'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files /home/node/.npm/_npx /root/.npm/_npx 2>/dev/null | rg '/playwright/package.json"'$'"' | head -4 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css && head -35 package-lock.json && npm config get package-lock && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && cat package.json && rg 'aria-describedby|aria-invalid' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.js && rg 'g-text-input__content|g-text-input__start-content' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.css | head -10"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,125p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.css && ls /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1254/chrome-linux-arm64/"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/{headless: true, args:/{headless: true, executablePath: '\\/home\\/node\\/.cache\\/ms-playwright\\/chromium-1254\\/chrome-linux-arm64\\/chrome', args:/; s/Сервис входа пока не подключён/Вход пока недоступен/\" /tmp/gravity-ui-check.mjs
node /tmp/gravity-ui-check.mjs"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright install-deps chromium'
/bin/bash -lc "cat /etc/os-release && ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1254/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found' && command -v apt-get && ls /var/lib/apt/lists | head"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/gravity-browser-libs
cd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs
apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libpixman-1-0 libthai0 libdatrie1 libgraphite2-3 libharfbuzz0b libfreetype6 libfontconfig1 libpng16-16 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libxrender1 libavahi-client3 libavahi-common3 libgssapi-krb5-2 libkrb5-3 libk5crypto3 libkeyutils1 libkrb5support0
for deb in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" extracted; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-ui-check.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-ui-check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1254/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found'
cd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs
apt-get download libwayland-server0
for deb in libwayland*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x \""'$deb" extracted; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-ui-check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'apt-get download libfribidi0 libxi6
for deb in libfribidi*.deb libxi6*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" extracted; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-ui-check.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'DEBUG=pw:browser LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-ui-check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'apt-get download fonts-dejavu-core fontconfig-config
for deb in fonts-dejavu*.deb fontconfig-config*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" extracted; done
cat > fonts.conf <<'"'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?>
<"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd">
<fontconfig><dir>/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/gravity-font-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-ui-check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc "DEBUG=pw:browser FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-ui-check.mjs > /tmp/gravity-browser-debug.log 2>&1
rg -i 'fatal|check failed|error|signal' /tmp/gravity-browser-debug.log | head -22"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -i 'fatal|check failed|signal|FATAL' /tmp/gravity-browser-debug.log"

/bin/bash -lc "ls /tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/*nss* /tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/*soft* && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libsoftokn3.so | rg 'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc 'apt-get download libsqlite3-0
for deb in libsqlite3*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" extracted; done
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-ui-check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-ui-check.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check && git status --short'
